lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Business and money (negotiate, deal, budget, invest, profit, revenue, expense, contract, invoice, afford, refund).

head: Palavra
Significado
Exemplo
rows: It's a good deal for both sides.
We have a small budget for marketing.
She invested in a small start-up.
The company made a profit of two million.
Please read the contract before you sign it.
I'll send you the invoice tomorrow.
We can't afford a new office.
The shop overcharged me by ten euros.

items: **make / earn** money, a profit; **save / waste** money; **owe** someone money
**sign / break** a contract; **meet / miss** a deadline; **stick to** a budget
**reach / close** a deal; **drive a hard bargain**
**pay in cash / by card**; **pay off** a debt; **pay back** a loan
"I want to make a investment." **Investment** começa com som de vogal: **an investment.**
"The enterprise has a good profit." Para empresa em geral use **company** ou **business**; **enterprise** soa muito formal.
"I will pass you the invoice." Em inglês, **send**: **I'll send you the invoice.**
"I can't afford to buy it, it's very expensive." Fica melhor: **I can't afford it. It's too expensive.**

I'd like a ___, please. The product is damaged.
Please read the ___ carefully before you sign it.

acc: I want to make an investment

lessons.title: Mixed conditionals e alternativas ao if
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: mixed conditionals e alternativas ao if (unless, as long as, provided that, in case, otherwise, suppose).

head: Tipo
Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.
If + past simple, would have + particípio
If I weren't so busy, I would have gone to the party.
I won't sign unless the price is lower.
You can borrow it as long as you return it.
Take cash in case the card doesn't work.
Pay now, otherwise you'll lose the discount.
Suppose they refuse. What will you do?

items: **Mixed conditional:** o if e o resultado estão em tempos diferentes. Passado que afeta o presente, ou uma situação do presente que mudaria o passado.
**unless** já tem sentido negativo. Não use *unless ... not*.
**in case** é por precaução, não é condição: *in case it rains* (não *in case it will rain*).
Depois de if, unless, as long as, provided, in case: **presente** para o futuro.
"If I would have studied, I would be a doctor." O certo é **If I had studied, I would be a doctor.**
"Unless you don't pay, we will cancel." O certo é **Unless you pay, we will cancel.**
"Take an umbrella in case it will rain." O certo é **in case it rains.**
"I will go as long as it won't rain." O certo é **as long as it doesn't rain.**

lessons.title: Inglês prático, negociar
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Negociar.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: I'd like to discuss the price. / Is there any room for negotiation?
What if we paid in advance? / We could offer you ten percent more.
We'll go ahead provided that you deliver by Friday.
I'm afraid that's more than we can afford. / That's a bit higher than we expected.
We could meet you halfway. / I could drop the price by five percent.
Let's agree on... / Do we have a deal? / I'll send you the contract today.

items: "Can you do a discount?" O certo é **Can you give me a discount?** ou **Is there any discount?**
"The price is very high for me." soa seco. Prefira **That's a bit more than I expected.**
"We make a deal?" Pergunta com auxiliar: **Do we have a deal?**
